replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states keys never expire and grant broad access; concrete permanent-access attack."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Key in query string is in design; log/proxy leakage attack is concrete and distinct."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Public API plus no rate limiting supports self-verifying key brute-force attack."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"No rate limiting on public endpoints supports flooding/capacity-exhaustion attack; harm differs from data theft."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Unthrottled access to all orders/emails supports distinct bulk PII harvesting attack."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Long-lived org-wide key per design; attribution/investigation harm distinct from prior threats."}]}
